title: Potato and Hazelnut Gnocchi Stuffed with Mozzarella
subtitle: in a creamy sun-dried tomato rose sauce
description: Baked potato and ground hazelnut gnocchi are filled with baby mozzarella, boiled until they float and tossed in a cream and sun-dried tomato sauce.

steps.text: For the sauce, heat the olive oil in a pan with the diced onion and garlic and fry until lightly golden. Add the sun-dried tomatoes, basil and thyme leaves and fry briefly. Season with salt and pepper and cook for about 10 minutes over medium heat. Add the cream, stir and cook for about 5 minutes over low heat. Blend until smooth (strain if needed) and return to the pan.
Place the potatoes on a bed of coarse salt and bake for about 40 minutes until soft.
Cool, peel and mash with a hand masher until smooth. Add the egg yolk, eggs, hazelnuts and flour and season with salt, pepper and a little nutmeg.
Roll the dough into long sausages 3 cm thick and cut into 3 cm pieces. Flatten each piece slightly, place a small ball of mozzarella in the centre and roll into a ball.
Cook the gnocchi in boiling salted water until they float. Lift out with a slotted spoon straight into the sauce, toss lightly, arrange on a serving plate and sprinkle with grated parmesan.
